name: Practice: D Chord & Rhythm
instructions: Play the D chord and strum four steady downstrokes, then release and reposition your fingers, repeating for five minutes.
Focus on one string at a time if a note is buzzing or muted -- identify which finger is the culprit before moving on.
Keep your fretting-hand thumb behind the neck, roughly opposite your middle finger, for the best leverage.
Revisit today's rhythm video as a refresher before you start.
